issue_context.summary: The reporter cannot find Snipping Tool while searching Command Palette for “snip”; the current thread is waiting on a targeted app-catalog and restart check.
known_information: The reporter reports PowerToys v0.101.2362.0 installed through WinGet on Windows 11.
Typing “snip” in Command Palette shows “Run Command” and “Remote Desktop”; Snipping Tool is absent from the observed results.
The collaborator asked whether it appears on Search apps and, if not, whether restarting Command Palette from the tray or Quit command changes the result.
The issue has no reported attachment; the Needs-Author-Feedback label is present.
inferences: If Snipping Tool is present in Search apps but not top-level search, the issue may be ranking/result selection rather than app discovery.
If it is absent from Search apps and appears after restart, the issue may involve catalog initialization or cache refresh; neither branch is confirmed.
issue_context.analysis: The upstream question already requests the smallest discriminator for All Apps discovery versus top-level search and for a stale provider/catalog state. Repeating it or proposing a fix before the reporter answers would duplicate current work.
initial_investigation: At upstream commit 1b33221dfa19f30d71409eb550807883fb27283a, src/modules/cmdpal/ext/Microsoft.CmdPal.Ext.Apps/AllAppsPage.cs::GetPrograms includes only enabled UWP apps and enabled, valid Win32 apps; BuildListItems refreshes when the app cache requests reload.
The current public discussion contains only the maintainer’s unanswered Search apps/restart request. No linked upstream PR or matching MuyuanMS fork issue, PR, or branch was found.
